INSERT INTO competitor_social_score_history (
    snapshot_date,
    competitor_id,
    platform,

    score,
    engagement_score,
    reach_score,
    activity_score,
    growth_score
)
SELECT
    CURRENT_DATE,
    competitor_id,
    platform,

    score,
    engagement_score,
    reach_score,
    activity_score,
    growth_score
FROM competitor_social_score
ON CONFLICT (snapshot_date, competitor_id, platform)
DO UPDATE SET
    score = EXCLUDED.score,
    engagement_score = EXCLUDED.engagement_score,
    reach_score = EXCLUDED.reach_score,
    activity_score = EXCLUDED.activity_score,
    growth_score = EXCLUDED.growth_score;
